summary: Busy residential kerb with cars parked; apartments and houses 19-22 m away.
reasons: Cars park along the whole kerb

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 19-22 m away on the west side; apartment blocks beyond; units opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line the kerb, so a van fits in the parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street just off a busy main road.
drivers.convention: Cars park here day and night, so a van blends in.

flags: Slope about 3.4% here, steeper further south
Dense apartments within 25 m all round
Low-lying near the top, about 4 m elevation
Noise from the main road at the top
sun_shade: Mixed tree cover over the road; shaded in the afternoon from the west buildings.

best_section.where: Durham Street west kerb, 25-45 m down from the main road corner
